text:
Type: perforated metal bell pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table, kitchen island or sitting area; dining room, kitchen, living room
Style: Scandinavian, retro, contemporary
Materials: lacquered metal shade with a pattern of small punched holes, cone-shaped ceiling cup, white fabric cord
Colors: warm light beige, ivory, warm glow inside
Shape: rounded bell shade flaring at the bottom edge, pinhole dots that sparkle in swirling lines, matching cone canopy, hangs on a long cord, medium size
Feel: soft, warm, gentle, cozy
Goes with: light wood, white or cream walls, linen, soft pastels; Scandinavian or retro dining rooms

product.name: SNIG
product.description: Safety tested and tamper-proof to protect little fingers.
